title: Melaka River Half Marathon 2026 Review: A Heritage-City 21K
seo_title: Melaka River Half Marathon 2026 Review | Malaysia UNESCO Race
meta_description: The Melaka River Half Marathon 2026: August 16 at Dataran Pengkalan Rama, Melaka. A 21.1K in Malaysia's UNESCO heritage city — registration now closed.
dek: Set for 16 August 2026 at Dataran Pengkalan Rama in Melaka — Malaysia's UNESCO-listed heritage city — this half marathon follows the Melaka River. Registration is now closed.
verdict: The Melaka River Half Marathon is a single-distance 21.1K along the Melaka River in one of Southeast Asia's most historically significant cities — a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its Dutch-colonial architecture, Jonker Street night market, and Peranakan culture. Registration is closed. Melaka is roughly 2 hours from Kuala Lumpur, making it a popular weekend destination. August in Melaka is the southwest monsoon — warm and humid but the riverside course provides some breeze.
